金色树冠映入湖水，留住一个温暖的秋日下午。: A golden tree reflects in a quiet lake on a warm autumn afternoon.
金色树冠与倒影分区清楚，可从树干和湖岸开始。: The golden canopy and its reflection form clear areas. Start with the trunk and lakeshore.
雨云渐渐散开，一道彩虹跨过明亮的草坡。: Rain clouds part as a rainbow arches above sunlit green hills.
从彩虹弧线与草坡明暗开始，云层的渐变适合慢慢分辨。: Start with the rainbow curve and the light and shadow on the hills, then work through the subtle cloud colors.
登录即可免费上传照片，自己慢慢拼；会员还可创建私人房间邀请朋友。: Sign in to upload photos and play solo for free. Members can also invite friends to private tables.
登录即可上传自己的图片: Sign in to upload your pictures
普通账号免费使用，最多保存 10 张。: Free for all accounts. Save up to 10 pictures.
每个账号最多保存 10 张图片。图片仅自己和受邀玩家可见，不加入公开图库或用时榜: Each account can save up to 10 pictures. Only you and invited players can view them; they stay out of the public gallery and leaderboard.
创建私人房间需要会员，独自拼图免费。: Private tables require membership. Solo play is free.
上传与独自拼图免费。只有创建私人房间需要会员，已有房间按 30 天规则保留。: Uploads and solo play are free. Only private table creation requires membership. Existing tables follow the 30-day retention rule.
登录免费，最多保存 10 张: Free with an account, up to 10 pictures
可额外创建私人房间一起拼: Also create private tables for friends
所有账号均可免费上传图片，选择 108–2000 片独自拼图。会员可用自己的图片: All accounts can upload pictures and play solo with 108–2,000 pieces for free. Members can also create private tables using their pictures to invite friends.
上传自己的图片和独自拼图始终向普通账号免费开放。: Picture uploads and solo play remain free for all accounts.
每局每人可查看原图和底图各一次，每次 30 秒；提示可用 3 次，每次标出最多: Each player gets one 30-second reference view, one 30-second underlay, and three hints highlighting up to three pieces and their positions. Reloading does not reset usage.
每局每人 3 次，每次标出最多 3 片及对应位置，持续 30 秒。: Three uses per player per puzzle. Each highlights up to three pieces and matching positions for 30 seconds.
每局每人可查看一次原图，持续 30 秒。: One reference view per player per puzzle, lasting 30 seconds.
每局每人可开启一次底图，持续 30 秒。: One underlay per player per puzzle, lasting 30 seconds.

把相同编号的拼块与桌面轮廓对应起来。: Match each numbered piece to the outline with the same number.
把拼块拖到画中的缺口，或点击「进入大厅」。: Drag the piece into the opening, or click “Enter the lobby”.
继续你参与过的公开拼图。: Return to public puzzles you have joined.
公开房间有人在拼时保留；无人且无进度时清理，已有进度保留约 24 小时。: Active public rooms stay. Empty rooms without progress are removed; rooms with progress stay for about 24 hours.
还没有未完成的公开拼图，去大厅选一张吧。: No unfinished public puzzles yet. Find a table in the lobby.
登录可保留账号下的拼图记录，公开大厅无需登录。: Sign in to keep puzzle records with your account. Public tables need no sign-in.
先找主体轮廓，再按颜色与明暗慢慢拼合。: Start with the main outlines, then follow colors, light and shade.
随机选图，按推荐片数创建公开房间: Pick a random picture and create a public table at its recommended count
柠檬与陶壶，盛着午后的暖光。: Lemons and a ceramic jug hold the warmth of the afternoon.
鲸尾轻轻划过海面，月光落在波纹里。: A whale tail brushes the sea beneath moonlit ripples.
海风吹过站台，下一趟旅程慢慢到来。: A summer anime scene: a seaside platform and a journey about to begin.
从人物、列车与向日葵的轮廓开始，再连接海天的颜色。: Start with the character, train and sunflower, then connect the sea and sky.
橘猫守着柜台，午后的面包香刚刚好。: A cozy anime bakery with a friendly shopkeeper and an orange cat.
先找橘猫、围裙和面包，再拼暖色的木质柜台。: Find the orange cat, green apron and bread before joining the warm wooden counter.
带着一封信和一点好奇，坐看浮岛与云海。: An anime courier and a little mechanical bird rest above a sea of clouds.
人物与红色邮箱轮廓清楚，云海和石阶可以分区慢慢拼。: Use the courier and red mailbox as anchors, then work through the clouds and stone steps.
共撑一把伞，让雨夜多一点暖色。: A colorful manga scene: two friends share an umbrella beside glowing windows.
先连接黄雨衣与蓝外套，再寻找路面的灯光倒影。: Join the yellow raincoat and blue jacket first, then follow the reflected street lights.
摊开星图，和小猫一起等月亮升起。: An original anime witch and her white cat share a quiet evening under the stars.
紫色衣裙、白猫和星图是清楚的线索，再连接夜空与远山。: Follow the purple dress, white cat and star chart, then connect the night sky and distant hills.
